publicContentUi.title: Articles and videos
publicContentUi.subtitle: Reviewed information about alternative medicine, each with a label showing how much evidence stands behind it.
publicContentUi.evidenceExplain_general_info: General background information. It makes no claim that a treatment works.
publicContentUi.evidenceExplain_traditional_use: Based on traditional practice; not tested to the standard of conventional medicine.
publicContentUi.evidenceExplain_limited_evidence: Some research exists, but it is small or of limited quality, so no firm conclusion can be drawn.
publicContentUi.evidenceExplain_studied: Has been examined in well-designed studies. Results can still differ from person to person.
publicContentUi.emptyBody: Our first reviewed articles and videos are on the way. Please check back soon.
publicContentUi.emptyFiltered: No articles or videos match these filters.
publicContentUi.overdueNotice: This content has not been reviewed recently. Information may be out of date; please check with a qualified practitioner.
publicContentUi.disclaimer: This content is for general information only. It is not medical advice, diagnosis or treatment.
publicContentUi.seeDoctorBody: If you have severe, sudden or worsening symptoms, or you are pregnant, or this is about a child or an older person, see a qualified doctor promptly. Do not delay or stop treatment you have been prescribed.
